svg.text: Expression is measured on a grid over the tissue
about one cell per 8 µm bin
Clusters of similar spots map tissue regions
Conditions are compared within a cluster, with slices as replicates
One slice per condition: spot-level test only (exploratory)
With a single-cell reference, cell types are assigned to spots and bins
Visium HD: a cell type per bin
Without a reference this step is skipped;
clusters are read through their marker genes.
